prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / image edit. The current portrait is identity-authoritative. The already adopted knight and healer portraits are drawing-style references only. Optimize the supplied character as one coherent member of that same illustrated game roster.

Preserve species, gender, character identity, main color scheme, distinctive equipment, pose direction and full silhouette. Keep weapons, wings, tails and feet fully inside the portrait. Preserve the specific previous costume and gesture choices; do not transfer clothing, ornaments, species or poses from the references.

Rendering: refined 2D Japanese anime game illustration with controlled volume and clean cel-shaded forms. Clearly visible dark slightly thicker outer contours, medium structural overlap lines, fine sparse interior lines. Smooth intentional taper. Strong silhouette definition like the adopted references, without a uniform sticker stroke. Keep depth, appealing nuanced anime faces and a few meaningful material highlights; do not flatten into a generic cartoon or make a photorealistic / 3D render.

Humanoid anatomy: balanced adult proportions, natural head-to-shoulder and torso-to-leg relationship, readable hands, grounded stance; no tiny head, elongated thighs, pinched pelvis or distorted joints. Adult men have clean appealing East Asian anime features appropriate to their age and role, neither oily western realism nor effeminate identical faces. Nonhuman creatures remain nonhuman; machinery remains machinery.

Hair: organized large masses and a small number of clear locks, tidy silhouette, only a few purposeful loose strands. Cloth: broad continuous matte color areas, a few folds where tension, joints and gravity require them; no patchwork shadow blocks or dozens of decorative creases. White cloth stays white with restrained soft shadows. Armor: physically coherent plates, clear joins and limited grouped highlights; retain necessary signature ornament, remove invented gratuitous metal flourishes, micro-engraving, sparkling bits and layered filigree. Do not convert cloth into metal. Creature surfaces and mechanical parts follow the same line hierarchy and coherent restrained shading while keeping required anatomy and functional structure.

Background: opaque low-saturation softly graded color field matched to the character palette. Mid-dark overall, gently lighter behind the head and upper body, deeper near edges and lower corners, restrained foot contact shadow. Choose a subtle gray undertone that separates character colors: slate blue-gray, smoky gray-violet, muted sage-gray or warm charcoal/taupe. Uniform collection treatment, quiet broad forms. No scenery, architecture, foliage, clouds, smoke, particles, symbolic backdrop, magic circles, text, watermark, border, bokeh, grain, noise or photographic lighting. Existing character-specific weapon energy may remain, but no added environment effects or new rim lighting.

Portrait composition 2:3, target 1024x1536. One character only. Retain enough breathing room around signature silhouette and weapons. The supplied unit is the content; references provide only drawing quality and background treatment.

Input images: Image 1 editable male swordsman content and identity; Image 2 adopted knight drawing style reference only. Substantially optimize the whole drawing: strong near-black tapered outer contours about3–5px at1024 width, medium overlap lines, very sparse thin interior marks. Adult male with appealing clean East Asian anime facial features, lavender-silver long hair, blue eyes, cool calm determined expression. Preserve his long hair, red waist sash streaming left, long white-lavender open coat, dark navy tunic and black trousers, existing silver small armor on shoulders/forearms/boots and cyan inset gems, right-handed cyan energy sword extending diagonally toward viewer right, relaxed other hand, front 3/4 stance and original palette. Organize long hair into 5–7 coherent broad flowing masses rather than dozens of looping strands; retain a few purposeful separated ends. White coat and red sash are soft matte cloth, broad continuous colors and very few gravity/tension folds; trousers soft black fabric, not plated metal or faceted shadow patches. Armor simplified coherent plates; remove gratuitous microstraps/filigree, retain necessary original gems. Correct excessive elongated body: balanced lean athletic adult, about8 heads tall, slightly larger head, credible shoulder width, pelvis and normal thigh length; no tiny head or stretched calves. Preserve sword with one clear continuous cyan blade and original hilt, no extra sparks/aura. Muted mid-dark warm slate gray backdrop, lighter behind head/upper body, dark edges. Full head/hair tips, coat, sash, blade tip and both boots safely framed2:3.

Finishing pass:
Use case: identity-preserve anatomy and ink finishing edit. Image1 current male swordsman is exact character, color, outfit, sword and gesture authority. Image2 adopted knight is proportion and dark-outline reference only. Keep the same adult male face identity, long lavender hair, dark cloth/silver small armor, white coat, red sash, cyan sword and stance. Make his anatomy visually balanced: the current head is too small and thighs/calves too elongated. Increase the head and neck scale relative to torso by about15–20%, bring shoulders into a natural relationship, shorten the entire legs by about12–15% with credible knees/ankles, resulting about7.8 head heights from crown to soles. He stays lean athletic and handsome, not childlike, bulky or feminine. Hands remain same plausible size. Do not transfer knight gold armor or haircut. Keep complete cyan sword and original relaxed other hand.
Apply stronger smoothly tapered near-black outer contours about3–5px at1024width like the knight, thinner lines inside. White coat and dark trousers are matte fabric; simplify into broad continuous value regions with only 3–4 required folds per garment, no crumpled angular dark mosaic around knees. Long hair remains long but group it into several broad flowing locks with far fewer stray ribbons and pointed flyaways. No new accessories or changing costume geometry. Same muted slate-gray softly graded background. Scale/composition can shift to preserve full hair, coat, red sash, sword tip and both boots safely inside2:3 frame; preserve grounded stance.
visual_notes: Preserves lavender-haired adult male swordsman, blue eyes, white coat, red sash, dark outfit and original cyan energy sword.
Second pass strengthens deep tapered external contours, slightly enlarges head and adjusts lean adult proportion, groups long hair into broad locks.
White coat maintains continuous matte light planes, slate-gray gradient remains quiet. Full sword/cloth/hair/boots present.
